compiled_rule.technosphere_information_loss: Only independently inspected exact ecoinvent3.9 cut-off named chemical markets are newly qualified, per positive1kg product. Preserve signed caller kg, supported uncertainty/formulas, foreground ownership and independent operations/emissions. Keep every original producer and final-freight entry separately at its source quantity and supported uncertainty, without normalization. Other releases, patches, system models, products and reverse routes gain no new permission. Whole native supplier inventories retain their own product references, process/allocation convention, upstream resources, energy, infrastructure, residues and releases once. Source/native processing, geographic/vintage, raw-material, water/emission coverage, allocation and internal uncertainty differ. Quantitative source/native LCI, LCIA, product-assay and stochastic equivalence are not established; score effects are unquantified. Use factor+1 per matching labelled kg, not an auxiliary-input, energy, economic-allocation, yield, purity, water, density or molecular-weight multiplier. Do not overlay source producer internals or emissions on complete native stocks. Final freight remains additional to native production upstream transport once. Retain source rail and heavy-road entries using complete native European rail/lorry fleet proxies, with geographic, traction/fuel/loading/infrastructure/vintage differences. No source mode is dropped, no distance/payload/load/loss factor or second raw-material delivery is invented. Native complete supplier/treatment quantities are not re-scaled to match the earlier database score. No caller/source literal omission, zero-burden treatment, avoided-product credit or runtime Python change. Earlier raw rules, recipes, review cards, approval operations and fingerprints remain unchanged. Only the independently reviewed3.9 profile selects these delivered-market helpers; the older default supplier identities remain frozen and receive no new approval. Shared Premise transformations and user experience remain unchanged. Retain the source eight-producer portfolio. Match the APME naphtha-cracking supplier and diaphragm, membrane and mercury chlor-alkali hydrogen coproducts to the same native technology roles individually. Do not replace this portfolio by the older native generic95%cracking/5%chlor-alkali mix or its historic cell shares. Four remaining small chemical-coproduct routes (amination, butanediol dehydrogenation, potassium hydroxide and pyridine synthesis), totalling0.0005481977977219994kg/kg, use the complete native industrial hydrogen mix as an explicit byproduct/technology/allocation screening proxy. Only this parent-market permission is granted, not standalone equivalence of those chemical plants to hydrogen manufacture.
